overview: In the Signature teaching of organizational behavior, What Organizational Behavior Studies is a load-bearing idea: understand it and much of the field clicks into place. vocabulary: Psychological safety: the belief that speaking up will not be punished.
Groupthink: the conformity pressure producing bad decisions.
